summary: Completed comprehensive testing of VenteFlash Auto vehicle buyback funnel. All backend APIs (100% pass rate - 20/20 tests) and all frontend flows working correctly. The complete funnel from landing page plate input through vehicle identification, progressive form reveal, estimation calculation, contact submission, to result page is fully functional.
passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with plate input and submit button
Landing page plate submission navigates to /car-search?car_info=PLATE
CarSearchPage with known mock plate (AA123BB) shows vehicle info with pre-filled fields
CarSearchPage with unknown plate generates a random vehicle
CarSearchPage without plate param shows manual plate input form
Progressive reveal: version selection + KM filled unlocks drivable section
Progressive reveal: drivable=yes unlocks additional boolean questions section
Progressive reveal: all 4 booleans answered unlocks contact section
Progressive reveal: drivable=no unlocks reason section AND contact section (no booleans needed)
Estimation calculation button works and shows price (3,850 EUR for Peugeot 208)
Contact form submission with all required fields navigates to /result-page
Result page shows 'Merci {firstname}' and estimation price for drivable vehicles
Result page shows no price for non-drivable vehicles
POST /api/autobiz/identify returns vehicle data for all 5 mock plates (AA123BB, CC456DD, GG012HH, KK345LL, AB123CD)
POST /api/autobiz/quote returns pricing data with base_price, final_price, discount_percent
POST /api/leads/save stores lead in MongoDB (verified 20+ leads in DB)
GET /api/leads returns saved leads with correct structure
Lead is saved to DB when result page loads (via saveLead call)
GET /api/settings returns configuration status
GET /api/ranges returns 6 seeded default price ranges
GET /api/centers returns 5 centers
GET /api/appointments/slots returns time slots
POST /api/tracking events working correctly
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 default price ranges on startup. Test leads created during testing with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All funnel flows tested and working. Mock plates: AA123BB (Peugeot 208), CC456DD (Renault Clio V), GG012HH (VW Golf 8), KK345LL (BMW Serie 3), AB123CD (Toyota Yaris). Unknown plates return random mock vehicles. Autobiz API is MOCKED in backend. HubSpot and Webhooks are stubbed (disabled). Key test IDs documented in agent_to_agent_context_note.

mocked_apis.autobiz_service.py: Vehicle identification and quotation fully mocked - returns predefined vehicles for known plates, random vehicles for unknown plates
mocked_apis.hubspot_service.py: Stubbed - logs info but doesn't send to HubSpot
mocked_apis.webhook_service.py: Stubbed - logs info but doesn't send webhooks
